sn29.3:1.3: Dragons who wished to be reborn as a human were encouraged to observe the sabbath ([pli-tv-kd1:63.4.3](), [ja506]()), during which they would cast off their serpent form (_vossaṭṭhakāyā_) and appear human (snakes are experts at skin-shedding). This seems to have been misunderstood in later days to imply that they should literally sacrifice their bodies, a belief unsupported in early Buddhism ([ja524]()).
sn29.3:2.2: “Both kinds of deeds” (_dvayakārino_): both good and bad. Contrast the good deeds for being reborn as a centaur ([sn31.2]()).
